arabic text: Amma meri amma..(3)\namma ruka na shimr e laee'n mere bayn se\nSattar qadam thi door ye zainab hussain se
english translation text: Mother, my mother \nMother, the accursed Shimr did not stop despite my lament;\nZainab stood only seventy steps away from Hussain.

arabic text: Bhai bhai pukarti rahi mai, phir bhi khanjar nahi ruka amma\nShimr ne ki phir aisi ghustakhi, mujhse dekha nahi gaya amma
english translation text: I kept calling 'Brother, brother,' yet the dagger did not stop, Mother.\nShimr then committed such insolence that I could not bear to watch, Mother.

arabic text: Tum jo zulfe sawara karti thi, unhi zulfo mein haath tha uska\nJaha'n bose diye the nana ne. usi gardan se khoo'n tapakta tha\nSare shabbir yu uthaye hue, shimr khaime tak aagaya amma
english translation text: The hair you used to comb was held within his hand;\nblood dripped from the very neck our grandfather had kissed.\nHolding Shabbir's head aloft, Shimr came towards the tents, Mother.

arabic text: Dekh kar mujhko bayn karte hue, shimr har baar muskarata raha\nMeri nazro ke saamne zalim, waar ginkar churi chalata raha\nHaye tera (13) zarbe thi kund khanjar tha, aur shabbir ka gala amma
english translation text: Seeing me lament, Shimr continued smiling;\nbefore my eyes the tyrant counted each blow as he moved the knife.\nAlas, there were thirteen strokes, the dagger was blunt, and it was Shabbir's throat, Mother.

arabic text: Charo janib se gher rakha tha, tere noore nazar ko lashkar ne\nTeer barsata tha koi uspar, Koi patthar se maarta tha\nHaye ret zakhmo pe wo girata raha, jisko patthar nahi mila amma
english translation text: The army had surrounded your beloved from every side;\none rained arrows upon him, another struck him with stones.\nWhoever found no stone threw hot sand upon his wounds, Mother.

arabic text: Tegh jis dum koi chali uspar, haye abbas kehke roya tha\nTeer peshani pe laga jis dum, haye asghar zabaa'n pe aaya tha\nHaye akbar pukara bhayya ne, jab bhi neza koi laga amma
english translation text: Whenever a sword struck him, he cried 'Abbas';\nwhen an arrow struck his forehead, Asghar's name came upon his lips.\nMy brother called 'Akbar' whenever another spear struck him, Mother.

arabic text:
Haye jab chalaya tha shimr ne khanjar, maine aanko'n se apni dekha
tha
Haath apne uthake pehlu se, tune sukhe gale pe rakha tha
Ungliya'n zakhmi hogayi hongi, haath mujhse to naa chupa amma
english translation text:
Alas, when Shimr moved the dagger, I saw it
with my own eyes; you raised your hand from your wounded
side and placed it upon his dry throat. Your fingers
must have been wounded—do not hide your hand from me, Mother.

arabic text: Aisi nafrat thi unke seeno mein, ye bhi socha na shaam walo ne\nDeen e islam mein zabiha tak, zibha pyaase nahi kiye jaate\nHaye teen din se hussain pyaasa hai, ye bhi socha nahi gaya amma
english translation text: Such hatred filled their hearts that the people of Shaam did not even consider\nthat within Islam even an animal is not slaughtered while thirsty.\nHussain had been thirsty for three days, yet they did not think of this, Mother.

arabic text: Maa ye zainab se kehti thi 'akbar', meri aaghosh mein tha sar uska\nMaine gardan ko katte dekha tha, maine saanso ko rukte dekha tha\nHaye aakhri baar zere khanjar bhi, Maine shabbir se suna amma
english translation text: The mother told Zainab, says "Akbar": his head rested within my embrace.\nI watched his neck being cut and his breathing stop.\nEven beneath the dagger, the final word I heard from Shabbir was "Mother".
